standing: Pre-execution control finding; not an observed Product/runtime failure. Original closed preparation preserved.

frames.EffectAndLifecycle: No template execution occurred. Correction affects operator evidence formatting only; actual SDK outcome, original resource close/successor and retained resume remain mandatory.
frames.Proof: Actual returned owner evidence and physical source/Result/close conjunction support closure. Metadata alone is not qualification, and serialized live capability is not required proof.

scope: Remove full call record/reread/hash and eager full-call error serialization, preserve original001; keep owner calls/grants/bounds, future admission remains null.
